insight: Started life as 'Roo Cline,' a fork of the Cline extension, before rebranding to Roo Code; released under Apache-2.0.
name: Roo Code
tagline: Open-source autonomous coding agent inside VS Code.
description: VS Code extension that turns the editor into an agentic coder with real file-system access, terminal control, and multi-step task execution. It ships role-specific modes — Architect, Code, Ask, Debug, Test — each with its own prompt and tool permissions, and can hand off between them mid-task. Model-agnostic: connect any provider key, from frontier APIs to a local model, and pay only for your own token usage.
edge: Forked from Cline to push harder on autonomy: customizable role-based modes that hand off mid-task, fully open and model-agnostic with no vendor lock-in.
pros: Custom role-based modes with own prompts
Run frontier APIs or a local model
cons: API token costs are on you
Centered on VS Code and forks
